scope: Upright common home monitors with three SYS/DIA/pulse rows
scoreNotice: Detection and recognition scores are not calibrated correctness probabilities

portraitCropFallback.acceptance: Only after no plausible full-frame reading; both views must be candidates with identical SYS/DIA/pulse; scores are not calibrated probabilities

adaptiveCropFallback.after: No plausible full-frame or agreeing central-crop reading
adaptiveCropFallback.acceptance: Two plausible complete readings must agree. Both must be candidates for candidate output; any low-confidence view keeps Please review status. Scores are not correctness probabilities.

displayRectificationFallback.after: No plausible full-frame, central-crop or adaptive normalized reading
displayRectificationFallback.acceptance: At least two perspective-corrected views must agree and no plausible view may disagree. Every recovered reading is returned for manual review.
